translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content.text: Dughiar mamɨn aseba Godɨn Nguibamɨn uari akuvazɨ,
men faragha ghua, akam me gasa kamaghɨn me mɨgei.
gumazir arazir kurabagh amiba bar me gifonge.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: Ia deragh gumazamizir uarira uarir akurvaghan koghamiba ko, borir afeziaba ariaghirezibar akurvagh.
Ia gumazamizir osɨmtɨziba ateriba ko, onganarazibagh amir gumazamiziba, deragh me damu.
Gumazamizir gavgaviba puvatɨziba ko, onganarazibagh amiba,
ia gumazir kurabar dafariba da ua me inigh.
“Me nɨghnɨzir aghuitam men itir puvatɨzɨ, me bizitam gɨfozir puvatɨ.
arazir aghuitam gumazamizibar akurvaghasa a gamir puvatɨ.
“Kɨ Godɨn Bar Pɨn Itim kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze,
Ia aser muziarir kaba, ia bar nan boriba.
Ia gumaziba ariaghiri moghɨn uaghan arɨmɨghiregham.
Ia atrivir igharaziba iri moghɨn uaghan iregham.”
O God, nɨ dɨkavigh izɨ nguazimɨn gumazamiziba bar me gativagh men araziba tuisɨgh.
Nguazimɨn itir gumazamiziba bar nɨn gumazamiziba.
